reviews.title: Why the high $$$$?
reviews.text: I just downloaded 10 fishing apps to check them out. This one gives you a “whopping” 7 day trial then wants to charge $49 a year. So far, the most expensive app yet and one of 5 that let you try it for free. I saw no difference between this one and 5 totally free ones. Deleted.

reviews.title: Money
reviews.text: Having to pay for more options

reviews.title: Watch out
reviews.text: Didn’t have my local lake, which is whatever. But had to sign up for premium to see that. They promote a free trial, but when you actually sign up, it sticks you for a full year.

reviews.title: Not what I was looking for
reviews.text: Don’t be like me and pay for a year to find out it’s not worth the money and doesn’t give proper depths and charts

reviews.title: Pay to use
reviews.text: Not worth your time or money. Everything is locked behind a paywall.

reviews.title: Not free
reviews.text: Yet another app that seems free on the surface, but ends up being a monthly subscription. Deceptive practices.

reviews.title: Garbage app
reviews.text: Has no depth chart.   Useless garbage app.   Waste of time

reviews.title: Need refund!
reviews.text: Total scam. This app wasn’t even in my subscription list. Took my hard earned money. $49.99. This app is useless. I will just stick to my other fishing app that actually shows other anglers catches and hotspots. And then they make it hard to actually leave a review! It says choose a nickname but every nickname I choose is taken? Yeah ok!

reviews.title: Used to be good, NOW WATCH COMMERCIALs
reviews.text:
I have no idea what’s happened to this app. 
I know that I pay for it and now all of a sudden I’ve got to watch advertisements!?!?!?

reviews.title: Ads and gatekeeping features
reviews.text: Every time u open the app there is an ads, this would be fine if it was free app, I am just  sick of features being behind a pay wall. If I wanna look at tomorrow’s tides I have to go to google, totally defeats the whole point to the app.

reviews.title: Lake did not even show up
reviews.text: Tried to use for ice fishing in New York and was standing in middle of the lake and didn’t even recognize I was on water. Looked into more lakes I fish and they are not on here. Apple DENIED refund even though was so misleading. You should clearly state somewhere that all states aren’t included. SAVE YOUR MONEY AND USE NAVIONICS.
